title: Concept: Dependency resolved with a classifier
description: pom.xml declares a dependency that pins a classifier artifact, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a dependency that pins a classifier artifact.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a dependency that pins a classifier artifact.
